entry.title: New: dsh-wallpaper-engine
entry.summary: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: renders local Video and Web wallpapers behind the chat with an iOS-style liquid glass effect and adjustable blur, dim, border and glass sliders. Exact install spec: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
